changelog: Massgram update: fixed stale unread reaction badges in chats.
Massgram update: added @kakadkl to testers, fixed reaction badges and telemetry crash reporting.

Massgram 12.6.4

- Fixed voice messages recorded with voice pitch enabled so the audio track is no longer empty.
- Changed locked chat badges to gray.
- Improved external share handling to avoid duplicate share screens and freezes.
- Updated Massgram settings testing and development credit.
Unified chat lock color and stronger locked preview blur.

Massgram 12.5.6

- Added Massgram+ features for Massgram-only premium stickers, custom emoji and todo messages between Massgram clients.
- Official Telegram clients still see an unsupported Massgram message placeholder, while Massgram clients decode and render the hidden premium content locally.
- Fixed Massgram premium transport, local premium gates and a crash during premium message decode.
- Improved Massgram private-message encryption and crypto compatibility for client-to-client transport.
- Added Massgram voice tools and fixed composer spacing around the voice pitch button.

Massgram 12.5.5

- Added an owner-only Massgram dashboard with total users, active now, offline counts and a searchable user list.
- Added a lightweight once-per-minute heartbeat while the app is open to power Massgram online and offline status in the dashboard.
- Heartbeat sends Telegram user ID, username or display name, app version, build channel, device model, Android version and locale.
- Heartbeat does not send chat history, message text, media, contacts or call audio.

Massgram 12.5.3

- Added profile Massgram indicator
- Added local AES chat encryption for private dialogs

Massgram 12.5.2

- Added beta update row in Massgram settings for selected testers.
- Stable rollout for all users.

Massgram update

- Initial public Massgram release
- GitHub Releases based in-app updater
- Current asset set: latest.json and massgram.apk
